messages:
Alex Support: Heads-up — PhotonPay opened a billing dispute. Their invoice for 2026-03-12 (INV-2026-PP-0312-09) shows ~36,821 tokens, but their dashboard total is ~18,367. They sent client logs and a short screen recording.

Mike (PhotonPay): trace id trace-pp-20260312-88, session=pp-ss-9f3. The client does a cancel then immediate reconnect while continuing the same logical session. They attached client-side socket logs.

Alex Support: Pulled their route-level breakdown in our Console: shows 18,367 tokens. Invoice definitely double that. Not a timezone cutoff.

Sam Billing: Put the invoice id and window here so I can run ledger queries.

Alex Support: Invoice: INV-2026-PP-0312-09. Window: 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-13T00:00:00Z. The trace above contains the reconnect that looks suspect.

Katie Eng: Looping in eng-infra and metering. Quick hypothesis: reconnect caused previously buffered partial chunks to be re-ingested under a new connection key, leading to duplicate meter rows.

Julia Recon: I exported raw stream events for trace-pp-20260312-88. Sanitized snippet below: \n```\nconn A (conn_id=conn-72) -> seq 1..9, token_deltas [4,7,11,0,8,9,5,13,2], many chunks had final:false\nclient sends cancel -> conn A closes\nconn B (conn_id=conn-81, same session pp-ss-9f3) -> resume request accepted -> server continues with seq 10.. and emits final:true later\n```\nWe see overlapping buffered micro-batches — some partial frames from conn A appear again when conn B resumes.

Katie Eng: What keys are we using in metering writes? If it's connection-scoped rather than session-scoped, duplication is exactly plausible.

infra-bot: metering-service v1.14.2 write key template = `meter:{connection_id}:{event_seq}`. Session-keying not enabled; streaming dedupe flag off for the 2026-02 streaming upgrade.

Katie Eng: That's the root cause. Reconnect creates a new connection_id; the same logical seq numbers get new rows. That matches ~2x delta we see here.

Sam Billing: That math checks out. Dashboard = ~18k, invoice ~36k. If ~half of streamed tokens were duplicated on write, invoice double-count makes sense.

Alex Support: Customer has paused workloads and is asking for immediate credit + RCA + ETA for fix.

Katie Eng: Short-term mitigation: hotfix to switch ledger keys to `meter:{session_id}:{event_seq}` behind a feature flag. Long-term: make ingest idempotent and add a reconciliation job that scans for duplicated seq ranges per session.

Julia Recon: QA repro steps for the bug (short):
1) Start stream with session_id=ss-X, open conn A, emit chunks seq 1..N with `final:false` for some chunks.
2) Close conn A (client cancel).
3) Open conn B reusing session_id ss-X, resume and continue; send final chunks.
4) Observe metering rows: under current prod keying you get duplicate rows for overlapping seq; after session-keying fix duplicates are prevented.

Katie Eng: Can someone create an emergency PR to change the key template and gate by a feature flag so we can canary it? I'll review immediately.

Sam Billing: I've pre-approved a provisional credit of $240 on INV-2026-PP-0312-09 pending the reconciliation. Marked invoice as under-review and notified Finance Ops.

Finance Ops: Received. Hold for final ledger diff after canary and reconciliation run.

Alex Support: I'll tell PhotonPay we applied a provisional credit and that we're prioritizing a hotfix + postmortem. Sharing expected timeline: hotfix PR + canary in 2–4 hours, full prod roll in ~8–12 hours if canary looks good.

infra-bot: deploy job created -> metering/session-keying-hotfix -> pipeline queued (priority=urgent).

Katie Eng: PR opened (#842-metric-session-keying). CI had one flaky test; re-run passed. Need ops to schedule canary in staging then prod.

Julia Recon: After applying session-keying locally and running repro, duplicates no longer appear. I'll run a ledger diff for the invoice window once canary is up.

Sam Billing: Assigning ledger diff task to Julia Recon to compute exact refund amount. Also capturing list of other customers with reconnect spikes to quantify exposure.

Alex Support: Thanks team. @Mike (PhotonPay) we'll DM a credit confirmation and follow up with a full RCA + postmortem. Leaving this thread open for updates and the final reconciliation amount.
